package agent_test

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/MichaelKinsy/PiG/ai"
)

// The upstream contentText default separator is a newline, including system blocks.
func TestHarnessTextSystemBlockSeparator(t *testing.T) {
	message := ai.SystemMessage{Content: ai.SystemTextBlocks{{Text: "first"}, {Text: "second"}}}
	if got := ai.RenderSystemMessageUpdate(message); got != "first\nsecond" {
		t.Fatalf("system block update = %q, want %q", got, "first\nsecond")
	}
}

// getSystemMessageText drops empty content/sections as well as null sections.
func TestHarnessTextEmptySystemSection(t *testing.T) {
	message := ai.SystemMessage{Content: ai.SystemText("base"), Sections: ai.OrderedSections{
		{Name: "empty", Value: new("")}, {Name: "removed", Value: nil}, {Name: "last", Value: new("last")},
	}}
	if got := ai.GetCurrentSystemPrompt([]ai.Message{message}); got != "base\n\nlast" {
		t.Fatalf("system prompt = %q, want %q", got, "base\n\nlast")
	}
}

// renderSystemMessageUpdate interpolates names literally, not as JSON/Go strings.
func TestHarnessTextSystemUpdateLiteralNames(t *testing.T) {
	message := ai.SystemMessage{Content: ai.SystemText(""), Sections: ai.OrderedSections{
		{Name: "a\"b", Value: new("new")}, {Name: "x\ny", Value: nil},
	}}
	want := "Updated system prompt section \"a\"b\":\n\nnew\n\nRemoved system prompt section \"x\ny\"."
	if got := ai.RenderSystemMessageUpdate(message); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("update = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
